title: Interview with Amy (5th + 6th Grade Math Teacher)
article:
When did you start working here?

Amy: In 2023.

Do you like teaching here?

Amy: I already felt a part of the community since my kids were here.

Did you teach a different subject before you came here?

Amy: Yes, I taught English.

What other reason do you like working here?

Amy: I like my fellow colleagues and I like that my students are curious.

Are you planning on teaching here for a while?

Amy: Yes, I don’t want to leave a community I like.

What are your favorite hobbies?

Amy: I really like puzzles, long walks with friends, hikes and cooking.
